advancements.essentialcraft5.hologram_re.en: Obtain a Remote Orbital Strike from the Holographic Projection
advancements.essentialcraft5.hologram_re.zh: 从全息投影身上获得轨道打击遥控器

advancements.essentialcraft5.hologram_gu.en: Obtain a Divider's Gun from the Holographic Projection
advancements.essentialcraft5.hologram_gu.zh: 从全息投影身上获得二分枪

tooltip.essentialcraft5.orbital_remote.u.en: Right-click a block within %s blocks: an orbital strike lands on it %s s later (%s MRU)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.orbital_remote.u.zh: 右键 %s 格内的方块：%s 秒后在那里落下一记轨道打击（%s MRU）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.orbital_remote.s.en: Creatures in the 5×5×5 around it take %s damage and catch fire, even through walls
tooltip.essentialcraft5.orbital_remote.s.zh: 落点 5×5×5 内的生物受 %s 点伤害并着火，隔着墙也一样

tooltip.essentialcraft5.orbital_remote.s.en: Spares you, your teammates and pets, villagers, and named or leashed creatures
tooltip.essentialcraft5.orbital_remote.s.zh: 不伤你自己、队友和宠物，也不伤村民、起了名字或拴着绳的生物

message.essentialcraft5.orbital_remote.n.en: No block within %s blocks to strike
message.essentialcraft5.orbital_remote.n.zh: %s 格内没有能打击的方块

tooltip.essentialcraft5.divider_gun.use.en: Hold right-click for 1 s: fire a divider projectile (%s MRU)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.divider_gun.use.zh: 按住右键 1 秒：射出一颗二分弹（%s MRU）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.divider_gun.fiel.en: %s s after it lands, hostile mobs within %s blocks lose half their health and are weakened, slowed and blinded
tooltip.essentialcraft5.divider_gun.fiel.zh: 落地 %s 秒后，%s 格内的敌对生物生命减半，并被削弱、减速、致盲

tooltip.essentialcraft5.divider_gun.only.en: Never touches players, villagers, animals or pets, and never kills
tooltip.essentialcraft5.divider_gun.only.zh: 不碰玩家、村民、动物和宠物，也不会致死
